name: Gemini 3 Pro
short: Google DeepMind's frontier Pro (1M, Deep Think) for agents/research; GPQA 91.9% and HLE 37.5% at $2/$12.
modalities: Text, image, audio, video, PDF in; text out
standout: The Deep Think research partner — Google’s pick for hard science questions and deliberative agent research where thinking longer beats responding faster.
tradeoff: Outclassed within its own family by Gemini 3.1 Pro at similar pricing; its main role today is budget-priced research work.
